attributes.context: This sentence is in Article Five (Union and Employer Responsibilities), Section 2, which also requires contractors to supply sufficient tools and equipment and schedule adequate workers, and is followed by a provision that there shall be no limitations on worker productivity or full use of tools and construction equipment.

extraction_text: The direction of the working force, the right to hire, to plan, direct, control and schedule all operations, in cooperation with other trades and the specified requirements of the user, shall be the responsibility of the contractor, including the right to establish, eliminate, change or introduce new or improved methods, machinery or techniques to efficiently perform all tasks.

attributes.context: The same section also assigns contractors responsibility to supply sufficient tools and equipment and to schedule an adequate number of workers, and a following section states there shall be no limitations on productivity or full use of tools of the trade and construction equipment.

attributes.context: The clause appears in Article Two, Trade or Work Jurisdiction, which defines the service work covered for mechanical equipment service journeymen and limits service employees to start-up and service of new installations.

extraction_text: Controls for automatic control for building HVAC systems, including electronic and digital controls, computer monitoring, hook-up, installation, including low voltage wiring, to be specified under the jurisdiction of mechanical service where applicable to service and retro-fit, but not conflicting with construction agreement.
